commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: create inventory-api app"
sudo -n mkdir -p /opt/inventory-api
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-api/app.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import json
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = [
    {"sku": "A100", "name": "Widget", "qty": 42},
    {"sku": "B200", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 17},
    {"sku": "C300", "name": "Gizmo", "qty": 8},
]

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, code, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._json(200, {"status": "ok", "pid": __import__("os").getpid(), "ts": time.time()})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._json(200, {"items": INVENTORY})
        else:
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
echo "STEP: create service user"
id -u inventoryapi >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo -n useradd -r -s /sbin/nologin inventoryapi
sudo -n chown -R inventoryapi:inventoryapi /opt/inventory-api

echo "STEP: create systemd unit"
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service > /dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventoryapi
Group=inventoryapi
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
# Protect this service from the kernel OOM killer so a runaway
# memory-hungry process is selected instead of this one.
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
OOMPolicy=continue

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF

echo "STEP: enable+start"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-api

sleep 1
echo "STEP: verify active"
systemctl is-active inventory-api
systemctl show inventory-api -p OOMScoreAdjust -p MainPID -p Restart

echo "STEP: verify http"
curl -sf "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"
echo
curl -sf "http://$NODE_IP:8080/inventory"
echo

echo "STEP: verify actual oom_score_adj of running pid"
MAINPID=$(systemctl show inventory-api -p MainPID --value)
cat /proc/$MAINPID/oom_score_adj

sudo -n dmesg -c > /tmp/dmesg-before.log || true

echo "STEP: write memory hog"
tee /tmp/memhog.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import time
chunks = []
try:
    while True:
        chunks.append(bytearray(20 * 1024 * 1024))
        for c in chunks:
            c[0:1] = b'\x01'
        time.sleep(0.05)
except MemoryError:
    time.sleep(5)
PYEOF

echo "STEP: launch hog in background (default oom_score_adj)"
setsid python3 /tmp/memhog.py > /tmp/memhog.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
HOGPID=$!
echo $HOGPID > /tmp/memhog.pid
echo "hog pid: $HOGPID"
cat /proc/$HOGPID/oom_score_adj

echo "STEP: poll memory + wait for oom event (up to 90s)"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 45 ]; do
  sleep 2
  i=$((i+1))
  if ! kill -0 "$HOGPID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "hog process exited/killed after ${i} polls"
    break
  fi
done
free -h
echo "STEP: dmesg oom lines"
sudo -n dmesg | grep -i -E "oom|killed process" || echo "no oom lines yet"
echo "STEP: hog still alive?"
kill -0 "$HOGPID" 2>/dev/null && echo "hog ALIVE" || echo "hog DEAD"
echo "STEP: inventory-api status"
